no_drive: ❌ The Drive connection is not set up: the repository secrets DRIVE_URL and DRIVE_KEY are missing.
retry_client: 🔁 YouTube blocked the {prev} client. Retrying with {next}...
cookies_used: 🍪 Using cookies from the YT_COOKIES secret.
cookies_logged_in: ✅ The cookies include a signed-in account.
cookies_bad_format: ❌ The cookies are not in the right format. Export them with the "Get cookies.txt LOCALLY" extension (Netscape format).
cookies_not_logged_in: ❌ The cookies have no signed-in account (LOGIN_INFO and SAPISID are missing), so YouTube ignores them. Export again from youtube.com while signed in.
hint_bot: 💡 YouTube is blocking GitHub's server. Save the contents of cookies.txt as a repository secret named YT_COOKIES and run again.
hint_update: 💡 yt-dlp may be outdated. Run again (every run installs the latest version).
upload_exists: ⏭️ Already in Drive (same name and size), not uploading again: {name}
drive_bad_key: DRIVE_KEY does not match the key in the Apps Script.
drive_no_token: The Apps Script returned no access token. Check that it is deployed as a Web app with access for Anyone.
drive_http_403: Google Drive refused (403). The Drive may be full, or the Apps Script is missing a permission.
drive_token_request: Could not reach the Apps Script address. Check that DRIVE_URL is the full Web app URL, starting with https://script.google.com/macros/s/ and ending with /exec.
hint_cookies_rotated: 💡 YouTube rejected the cookies (they were rotated in the browser). Export new ones in a private window: sign in to YouTube, go to youtube.com/robots.txt in the same tab, export, close the window right away, and save YT_COOKIES again.
no_drive_rclone: ❌ Upload through rclone is not set up: the repository secret RCLONE_CONF (with a remote named gdrive) is missing.
rclone_failed: rclone failed (code {code}). If a token error appears, reconnect and save RCLONE_CONF again.
time_limit: ⏱️ The download will stop after {minutes} minutes, and whatever was recorded will be uploaded to Drive.
time_up: ⏱️ Time is up. Stopping the download and uploading what was recorded...
time_limit_bad: ⚠️ '{value}' is not a number of minutes. Continuing without a time limit.
time_limit_capped: ⚠️ The time limit was lowered to {minutes} minutes, the most a GitHub run allows.
cookies_rotated_stop: 🛑 YouTube rejected the cookies, so the download stops. Without a signed-in account YouTube blocks the download.
nothing_uploaded: ❌ No file was downloaded, so nothing was uploaded to Drive.
hint_blocked: 💡 YouTube temporarily blocked the GitHub server this run got (error 403 or 429). The video itself is probably fine. Every run gets a different server, so running again usually works.
hint_no_subs: 💡 The video has no subtitles in the chosen language ({langs}). Try another language, or all for every language.
retry_new_server: 🔁 Starting another attempt on a new server ({next} of {max}). It shows up as a new run in the Actions list.
retry_exhausted: 🛑 YouTube kept blocking after {max} attempts on different servers. Wait a while and run again.
attempt: 🔁 Attempt {attempt} of {max}, on a new server.
